tracks.title: 輪仔內底的戒指 Lián-á Lāi-té ê Kài-tsí
tracks.subject: A Pingtung roadside tyre-repair man finds a gold ring wedged in the tread of a scooter tyre and holds it up at the red light for every passing rider, until a delivery woman who lost it a week ago stops; she says she had already bought a new one but still wants this one.
